autoProxyFallback.description: Transparently retry a fetch via Apify residential proxy when the direct request looks like a block page (empty body or unusually small response). Saves credits by only using the proxy when needed.
autoProxyFallback.title: Auto proxy fallback

channelUrls.description: List of YouTube channel URLs to scan for contact emails. Supports @handle, /channel/UC..., /c/name, /user/name formats, and plain @handle shortcuts.
channelUrls.title: YouTube channel URLs

followExternalProfiles.description: When true, the scraper also opens external profile links advertised on the channel (Instagram, TikTok, Linktree) to discover emails hidden in their bios.
followExternalProfiles.title: Follow external profiles (Instagram / TikTok / Linktree)

maxExternalPerChannel.description: Upper bound on how many external profile URLs are fetched per channel (keeps runs cheap and predictable).
maxExternalPerChannel.title: Max external profiles followed per channel
